summary: Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A. furnished a Form 6-K containing the English translation of a payment notice for its Series XLVII fixed-rate notes, principal USD 64,417,023 due 2028. The fourth semiannual interest installment, covering May 15 to November 15, 2026, pays USD 2,273,126.73 at a 7.00% annual nominal rate, effective November 16, 2026, via paying agent Caja de Valores S.A., to holders of record November 13, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural change is stated; this is a routine debt-service notice, not a special situation. Watch for future note amortization or refinancing disclosures.
